name: KIC 9713617
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 5.0 solar radii and 1.13 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 9713617 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 5.0213 +/- 0.0861

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 9713617 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.1298 +/- 0.043

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 9713617 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4631.209 +/- 41.0509

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 9713617 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 3.0912 +/- 0.0037

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 5 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.13 solar masses and 5.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,631 K at its surface.
